strings.string: Creates dovetails on a sketch line. Pick a line, then set count / size / depth / tolerance.
Moves the teeth along the line by one step. Limited to the range in which they still fit entirely on the line.
Please select exactly one sketch line.
The selected line has no length.
The width must be greater than 0.
The depth must be greater than 0.
The tolerance must not be negative.
At least one dovetail is required.
The flank angle must be between -89 and 89 degrees.
The flank angle is too steeply negative - the tooth tapers away to nothing.
The spacing must be greater than 0.
The spacing is too small - the dovetails would overlap. At least {0} mm is required.
The offset pushes the teeth past the end of the line. At most +/- {0} mm is possible.
The teeth are wider than the selected line ({0} mm). Reduce the count, the width or the spacing.
The mating contour runs away at a sharp corner. Make the tooth flatter (less depth / more width) or reduce the tolerance.
The tolerance eats the whole tooth. Reduce the tolerance or increase the depth.
The tolerance is too large compared to the depth.
The tolerance is too large compared to the width.
No suitable toolbar panel was found.
